verdict.rationale: Anytype docs claim linking and a Graph that shows 'every Object...and how they connect' (docs-9, docs-28, docs-40), but there is no mention of wiki-style [[bracket]] syntax, explicit 'backlinks' panel, or 'unlinked mentions' detection anywhere in the docs. A hands-on community report directly contradicts the graph-based connection-tracing claim, saying the graph view is 'totally useless if you have at least hundreds of objects' (anytype-comm-5), undermining the core 'see every backlink...in context' promise at realistic scale. missing for 10: explicit [[wiki-link]] syntax, a dedicated backlinks list, unlinked-mention detection, and independent confirmation that connection-tracing works well at scale.
